annotations.title: Look at a URL for a table

description: Fetch a URL once, changing nothing in the show: HTTP status, content type, an outline of the JSON (keys, their values, array lengths) or the page's title and text, and the rows a table would get from it with connector, pick and headers — or, with connector mcp, an MCP server's tools, or one tool's rows with tool and args. Use it before creating a URL or MCP table, and to find the pick path or selector. (In a scene's draft; scene: its id.)

args.description: mcp, with tool: the arguments to call that tool with, shaped as its input schema (a probe without tool lists each tool's schema). Omitted: none

connector.description: How to read it as rows (default: from the content type); mcp: the URL is an MCP server

headers.description: Request headers, e.g. { Authorization: "Bearer <key>" } — a key the user gave, never a guessed one

pick.description: json, mcp: a path into the document or the tool's result, e.g. chart.result[0].meta — an array there is the rows, an object one row; html: a CSS selector, each match a row

scene.description: The scene (scn_…), from list_scenes or create_scene.

tool.description: mcp: the tool to call; without it, the server's tools are listed

url.description: The http(s) address to read: a JSON API, a CSV or spreadsheet file, a Google Sheet, a web page, or with connector mcp an MCP server's endpoint

name: scene_probe

code.description: Stable — branch on it: INVALID_INPUT, REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_PUBLISH, CONFIRM_REQUIRED, UNAVAILABLE, …

currentRevision.description: CONFLICT: the revision it has now

detail.description: What is wrong, in a sentence

errors.description: Each problem, when a check refused it
